lineage.description: Population projection data for Central Sulawesi Province derived from Indonesian national census data (BPS) and compiled by BNPB with UNFPA support. The dataset provides administrative-level population estimates at sub-district (Adm4) resolution to establish baseline exposure for disaster risk assessment in an earthquake and tsunami-prone region.
